kinpaku.description: The mark's line, a hairline, the lit dot on a control, the AI-tell tag, the primary button fill. Never text on paper.

kinpaku-vivid.description: The lit hover on a gold fill: the popup's Scan page button under the pointer.

kinpaku-rich.description: Hover on a pressed gold control (the walks mic), the focused field's inset ring, and the sidebar's AI-tell marker glyph.

patina-deep.description: Any text that has to be colored: selectors, finding details, the copied state. Clears 4.5:1 on paper.

paper.description: Page ground of the DevTools panel and sidebar, and the toolbar.

ink.description: The mark, wordmark, names and active labels.

on-gold.description: The only foreground on a gold fill: tag, badge, primary button.

kinpaku-deep.description: A gold border against paper: a pending item in component review, the walks panel's focus outline.

patina.description: The quality dot and the 2px focus outline. Never text.

patina-pale.description: Fill of the page-level finding tag.

vermilion.description: Failure only: the line that says a scan did not run.

paper-raised.description: Popup ground, and every raised cap: tool button, segmented cap, switch knob.

paper-deep.description: Row hover, the settings well, the secondary button.

gray.description: Segmented track, quiet chips and counts, secondary button hover.

gray-2.description: Switch track and an unlit indicator dot.

text-muted.description: Descriptions, section labels, resting tool icons.

text-faint.description: Chevrons, group counts, the resting copy button.

text-mute-deep.description: Disabled and off states: the zero count, hidden overlays.

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Paper hardware: a recessed track carrying raised caps, the selected cap's dot lit gold.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border-radius: 3px; background: oklch(92% 0 0); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 3px oklch(13% 0 0 / 0.16), inset 0 -1px 0 oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.7); font-family: "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-seg button { position: relative; padding: 3px 9px 3px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: oklch(46% 0 0); font: 500 11px/1.4 "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); } .ds-seg button::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 6px; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: oklch(88% 0 0); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px oklch(13% 0 0 / 0.18); } .ds-seg button:hover { color: oklch(13% 0 0); } .ds-seg button.active { background: oklch(99.5% 0 0); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.9), 0 1px 0 oklch(13% 0 0 / 0.14), 0 2px 3px oklch(13% 0 0 / 0.08); color: oklch(13% 0 0); } .ds-seg button.active::before { background: oklch(84% 0.19 80.46); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(13% 0 0 / 0.12), 0 0 4px oklch(84% 0.19 80 / 0.6); } .ds-seg button:active { box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px oklch(13% 0 0 / 0.14); transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(70% 0.12 188); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Switch
components.description: A recessed track, a raised paper knob, a dot that lights gold when on.
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 30px; height: 18px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 0; height: 0; } .ds-switch-track { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(88% 0 0); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 3px oklch(13% 0 0 / 0.16), inset 0 -1px 0 oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.7); } .ds-switch-track::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: oklch(99.5% 0 0); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.9), 0 1px 0 oklch(13% 0 0 / 0.14), 0 2px 3px oklch(13% 0 0 / 0.08); transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.3, 0.7, 0.2, 1); } .ds-switch-track::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 7px; left: 7px; width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: oklch(88% 0 0); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px oklch(13% 0 0 / 0.18); transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.3, 0.7, 0.2, 1), background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-switch-track::before, .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-switch-track::after { transform: translateX(12px); } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-switch-track::after { background: oklch(84% 0.19 80.46); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(13% 0 0 / 0.12), 0 0 4px oklch(84% 0.19 80 / 0.6); } .ds-switch input:focus-visible + .ds-switch-track { outline: 2px solid oklch(70% 0.12 188); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tool Button
components.description: The DevTools toolbar's control: transparent at rest, a raised cap under the pointer, a lit dot when held.
components.css: .ds-toolbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 7px 10px; background: oklch(97.8% 0 0); border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(13% 0 0 / 0.12); } .ds-tool { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 26px; height: 26px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: oklch(46% 0 0); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); } .ds-tool:hover, .ds-tool.active { background: oklch(99.5% 0 0); border-color: oklch(13% 0 0 / 0.12); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.9), 0 1px 0 oklch(13% 0 0 / 0.14), 0 2px 3px oklch(13% 0 0 / 0.08); color: oklch(13% 0 0); } .ds-tool:active { box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px oklch(13% 0 0 / 0.14); } .ds-tool.active::after { content: ""; position: absolute; bottom: 2px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: oklch(84% 0.19 80.46); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(13% 0 0 / 0.12), 0 0 4px oklch(84% 0.19 80 / 0.6); } .ds-tool:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(70% 0.12 188); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Finding Row
components.description: One finding: the patina-deep mono selector is the only colored text; the description shows on hover.
components.html: main > section.hero h1Gradient text on the headline
components.css: .ds-finding { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; padding: 4px 6px 5px 26px; border-radius: 3px; font-family: "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); } .ds-finding:hover { background: oklch(95% 0 0); } .ds-finding-selector { font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", SFMono-Regular, "JetBrains Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 11px; color: oklch(46% 0.08 188); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-finding-detail { font-size: 11px; color: oklch(22% 0 0); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: The detector's own label: ink on gold for an AI tell, gray and muted for quality.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 16px; padding: 0 5px; border-radius: 3px; background: oklch(84% 0.19 80.46); color: oklch(14% 0.018 95); font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", SFMono-Regular, "JetBrains Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tag.is-quiet { background: oklch(92% 0 0); color: oklch(46% 0 0); }

components.name: Buttons
components.description: Popup buttons: the one gold primary, paper-deep secondaries.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-btn">Copy all</button> <button type="button" class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary">Scan page</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: oklch(95% 0 0); color: oklch(13% 0 0); font: 500 13px "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: oklch(92% 0 0); } .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(84% 0.19 80.46); color: oklch(14% 0.018 95); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(87% 0.20 85); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(46% 0.08 188); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Surfaces are neutral paper (chroma 0) and type is ink: no warm cast, no dark section backgrounds. Gold is jewelry. A raised or dark surface is something you operate: a recessed track, a raised cap, a lit gold dot. One light theme everywhere, including inside dark DevTools, where the panel is a sheet laid on the tool with a hardened ink seam.
keyCharacteristics: Chroma-0 paper and ink; color appears only as gold jewelry, patina state or vermilion failure.
Controls are paper hardware with real depth; everything else is flat.
Dense UI: 11px is the floor for anything functional.

rules.name: The Gold Is Jewelry Rule
rules.body: Kinpaku fills the mark, a hairline, the lit dot on a control, the tag and the one primary button. It never carries text on paper and never fills a panel.

rules.name: The Gold Text Is a Bug Rule
rules.body: Gold at 84% lightness lands under 2:1 on paper. Text that has to be colored is patina-deep, which clears 4.5:1. Text on a gold fill is on-gold.

rules.name: The Severity Rule
rules.body: One mapping, everywhere. AI tell: the gold tag and a lit gold dot. Quality: a patina dot and patina-deep text, never competing with the gold. Failure: vermilion, only for a scan that did not run.

rules.name: The Mono Means Machine Rule
rules.body: Selectors, counts, section labels and tags are mono, as in the agent. Labels are uppercase and tracked (0.12em).

dos: Do read every value from the `--ks-*` tokens rather than hand-typing oklch.
Do give every lit indicator the LED glow, and only lit indicators.
donts: Don't set gold text on paper.
Don't add a dark theme or a dark section background; tune the seam instead.
Don't use vermilion for anything but a failed scan.
